maria-sec: Heads-up: I'm proposing we shorten dev log retention from 90d -> 14d to cut SIEM costs.
jon-ops: what about exports for investigations? legal needs durable copies for e-discovery.
kate-sre: can we keep prod at 365d and export periodic snapshots to an encrypted S3 (CMK-backed)? :thinking_face:
maria-sec: yes — plan idea: prod -> SIEM 365d; scheduled exports to s3://secure-logs with CMK wrap. dev -> 14d and exports disabled unless tagged `retain_for_investigation`.
mike-infra: tagging is doable. We'll also need RBAC: only `security:forensics` and `legal:ediscovery` groups can request exports and set retain tags.
ana-legal: (Ana) legal needs a request workflow, audit trail, and retention justification captured on export.
jon-ops: who approves requests? can we gate via Jira + OPA policy? oncall-bot: approval-policy required
kate-sre: propose automated approval when `incident_id` is present AND requestor in security team; otherwise manual approval by security lead.
maria-sec: another concern: CMK rotation — will rotating CMKs break ability to decrypt historic exports?
mike-infra: rotation won't break if we keep previous key versions and grant decrypt to service principal; we'll document key policy and add rewrap steps for imports.
jon-ops: add a playbook step and a canonical export command. Example:
```
aws s3 cp /tmp/export.tar s3://secure-logs/2026-03-23/incident-123.tar --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01
```
kate-sre: RBAC proposal: new roles `export:create` (request), `export:approve` (security lead only), `export:download` (forensics & legal). Split privileges to enforce review.
maria-sec: timeline? need this in place by EOD Friday to hit cost targets.
mike-infra: I'll open infra-iam PR with role defs and key policy changes.
jon-ops: I'll author OPA policy with conditions: department, incident tag presence, legal_flag, and add a deny if retention_days > 365 without approval.
ana-legal: legal signoff on metadata: require `legal_hold` boolean, `case_id` optional, and keep audit trail for 7 years.
kate-sre: integrity: require HMAC+manifest for every export so we can prove tamper-free chain. manifest sketch below:
```
{
  "export_id": "incident-123",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-23T15:01:00Z",
  "case_id": "CASE-2026-45",
  "retention_days": 365,
  "legal_hold": false,
  "hmac": "sha256:..."
}
```
maria-sec: OK plan items: (1) infra IAM PR (mike), (2) OPA policy + request flow (jon), (3) export job template + manifest schema (kate), (4) legal metadata & audit retention (ana), (5) KMS rotation/runbook doc (mike). I'll draft RFC and link it here.
jon-ops: pinging @ana-legal for final metadata signoff.
ana-legal: signoff on metadata pending default `legal_hold=false` and audit trail storage for 7y; require explicit justification in Jira.
oncall-bot: reminder: deploy window 2026-03-26 02:00-04:00 UTC.
maria-sec: thanks all — I'll draft the RFC and post a PR link. :thumbsup:
